title: [SYNTHETIC FIXTURE] Spec-Driven Development with AI Coding Assistants: An Empirical Study of Amazon Kiro
abstract: We evaluate Amazon Kiro adoption across enterprise engineering teams. Controlled analysis demonstrates that spec-driven development reduces architectural drift and increases routine feature delivery throughput by 24% while enforcing security constraints.

title: [SYNTHETIC FIXTURE] Measuring Developer Productivity and Delivery Trade-offs with Generative Assistants
abstract: Empirical analysis of 350 developers shows that generative assistants improve code generation speed but require rigorous automated gate checks to prevent regression risks in multi-service production environments.
venue: ACM Transactions on Software Engineering and Methodology
